author: nutri_momma
caption: Simple homemade magnesium lotion! 🌿 4 ounces of unrefined shea butter, 2 tablespoons beeswax, and 1/2 cup of avocado oil — put that in a double boiler and melt low and slow. Remove from heat. Mix 2 tablespoons of hot water with 4 tablespoons of magnesium flakes until it has dissolved, then add it to the oil and shea butter mixture. Add 10 drops of essential oils of your choice, or none at all. Let it sit until it firms back up, then use an immersion blender to your desired consistency. Put it in clean dry jars!  I'm hoping this is going to help me after a long day —  my go-to for winding down and helping my muscles feel less tight.
